description: The full test plan + release hygiene: the fast/mocked unit suites, the new live-DB fees behavioral suite (glob already registered in FEAT-002), the cross-tenant escape suite extended to every new tenant-owned table, all the headline money/idempotency/tenancy tests plus the 3 approved-review NIT tests, a clean `npm ci` build check and the live smoke run, the roadmap deferred-frontend + slice-7.1 note updates, and the commit on main (NO push/deploy). Depends on FEAT-001/002/003 (the schema, routes/webhook/services, and seed must exist). Grounded in design §A.5/§D.17 and review NITs 1/2/3. Leaves the repo in a committed, green state on main.
steps: Read context.json and design §D.17 + §A.5 FIRST, plus apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/helpers/tenant-escape-setup.ts and tenant-escape.integration.test.ts (the extension pattern) and module-system.integration.test.ts (the adminClient owner-role seam).

Extend tenant-escape-setup.ts: add the six new tables to RLS_TABLES (fee_structures, fee_components, student_charges, payment_transactions, payment_allocations, receipts, processed_webhook_events — note payment_transactions/student_charges use the standard select+modify pair, the three append-only tables use the SELECT + <table>_tenant_insert pair in EXPECTED_POLICIES). In seedTenant seed the mutable/guarded tables (a FeeStructure + FeeComponent, a StudentCharge on the already-seeded studentProfile, a payment_transactions CREATED row with a targetChargeIds array) via adminClient; do NOT seed the fully-append-only tables through the generic loop (their triggers block even adminClient on teardown — the application_reviews/student_profile_history precedent) nor leave a payment_transactions row in a terminal frozen state that teardown cannot delete (the guard trigger forbids DELETE — so either exclude payment_transactions/student_charges from the generic delete loop and disable their trigger for teardown like the audit_events dance, OR seed them in a non-terminal deletable form and document the chosen approach in findings). Extend cleanup() (child-first) and countRemainingTestRows() accordingly.

Add escape assertions in tenant-escape.integration.test.ts over the new tables: read escape (A cannot read B's fee rows by id or via list), write-escape-foreign-parent (a charge referencing another tenant's student is rejected by the composite FK + WITH CHECK), write-escape-spoofed-tenant (insert stamped with B's institutionId under A is rejected), deliberately-buggy-query (an unfiltered findMany under A returns only A's rows), missing-context fail-closed (no tenant GUC -> zero fee rows).

Author the fast/mocked unit suites (no DB; run under `npm test -w @campusgate/api`): HMAC verify valid/invalid/constant-time with a mocked secret; webhook field extraction from the nested payload + headers (payment-event order_id vs order-event id paths, HIGH-1); the BigInt->Number boundary guard (rejects 0n and > Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, accepts a realistic amount losslessly); allocation math in BigInt (oldest-due-first, partial vs full, overpayment-leaves-remainder, all-targets-PAID, sum <= amount); money-as-string JSON serialization; charge-status transition logic; receipt-number/sequence format; the PaiseAmount Zod schema (accepts a positive paise string; rejects '0', leading zero, decimals, signs, non-numeric, > Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER; rejects a JSON-number input); the Razorpay service with a mocked SDK (order create + reconcile reads); and the fail-closed role probe throws when handed an RLS-subject connection.

Author apps/api/src/<path>/fees-behavioral.integration.test.ts (live-DB; the glob FEAT-002 added to LIVE_DB_SUITES), importing the tenant-escape-setup seam so DATABASE_URL is pinned to campass_app and injecting adminClient as the webhook's owner-role lookup client. Cover the HEADLINE tests: duplicate webhook delivered twice -> exactly one CAPTURED tx, one receipt, one allocation set, second delivery 200 no-op; tampered webhook signature rejected (401, nothing written); invalid payment (checkout) signature rejected (400, no charge paid / no receipt); charge PENDING->PAID only after the webhook (Stage-2 verify leaves it AUTHORIZED, never PAID); allocation sum <= payment; module-gated op route 403 when fees SUSPENDED while the webhook stays signature-gated and still processes; ACCOUNTANT gets 403 on a non-fees route; a STUDENT sees only their own ledger; exact paise math end-to-end; the append-only triggers reject UPDATE/DELETE on the three locked tables and the column-guard triggers reject illegal mutations (reverse transition, terminal re-update, snapshot/fact-column mutation incl. an explicit targetChargeIds mutation, any DELETE); computed outstanding == charges - allocations. PLUS the 3 NIT tests: (NIT-1) a targetChargeIds entry pointing at another tenant's / a non-existent charge contributes zero allocation; (NIT-2) reconcile leaves a still-open order in place (not FAILED) and only drives FAILED on a terminal-failed signal; (NIT-3) a NON-23505 processed-event insert failure does NOT return 200 (rolls back so Razorpay retries).

Run the fast suite `npm test -w @campusgate/api` and fix any failures; then run `npm run test:integration -w @campusgate/api` for the new fees + extended escape + re-pointed module-system suites, retrying transient pooler errors (P1001 / max clients) per the harness convention.
Clean-build check: `npm ci` at the repo root, then `npm test -w @campusgate/api` green; run `npm run test:integration -w @campusgate/api` once more as the live smoke.

Update docs/roadmap.md: add the Phase 7 slice-1 'Deferred frontend scope' note (Option A — backend only; apps/web fees UI deferred) and the slice-7.1 note (scholarships, concessions, waivers, fee adjustments, refunds, the full report set land as NEW ledger-entry tables + new allocation entries + forward charge-status transitions, never edits to posted student_charges / CAPTURED payment_transactions / payment_allocations / receipts; fees.refund/fees.adjust are forward-declared unbound keys wired with MFA step-up in 7.1).

Clean up any temporary files created during verification. Stage ONLY the intended files (never .env or real keys) and create ONE commit on main with a Conventional-Commits message (e.g. 'feat(fees): phase 7 slice 1 — fees ledger + Razorpay payment spine (backend)'). Do NOT push and do NOT deploy. Record the commit hash in findings.
acceptance_criteria: `npm test -w @campusgate/api` passes (the full fast suite stays green, ~382+ the new fees unit tests).
`npm run test:integration -w @campusgate/api` passes the new fees-behavioral suite, the extended tenant-escape suite over all six new tables, and the re-pointed module-system suite.

Each headline acceptance test asserts the stated outcome: duplicate webhook posts exactly once; tampered webhook signature -> 401 writes nothing; invalid payment signature -> 400 no receipt; charge PENDING->PAID only after webhook; allocation sum <= payment; module-SUSPENDED op route 403 while webhook stays signature-gated; ACCOUNTANT 403 on a non-fees route; student sees only own ledger; exact paise math; and the 3 NIT tests pass.
`npm ci` then the fast suite is green (clean build); the live smoke run is green.
docs/roadmap.md carries the deferred-frontend + slice-7.1 notes; ONE commit exists on main with only the intended files staged (no .env/secret) and nothing pushed/deployed.
verification: npm run test:integration -w @campusgate/api — green (fees-behavioral + tenant-escape + module-system)
npm ci (repo root) then npm test -w @campusgate/api — green
git log -1 --stat shows one new commit on main with only intended files; git status clean; git log shows it is NOT pushed
findings:
DONE.

ESCAPE SUITE (apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/helpers/tenant-escape-setup.ts + tenant-escape.integration.test.ts): extended over ALL SEVEN Phase-7 fees tables (the brief says 'six' but the slice adds seven: fee_structures, fee_components, student_charges, payment_transactions, payment_allocations, receipts, processed_webhook_events). RLS_TABLES += the seven; EXPECTED_POLICIES += the append-only pair {tenant_isolation_select, <table>_tenant_insert} for the three fully INSERT-only tables (payment_allocations/receipts/processed_webhook_events); the four mutable/guarded tables fall through to DEFAULT_POLICIES (standard select+modify pair) — the column-guard triggers enforce immutability at the ROW level, not via an append-only RLS policy, so they correctly still carry tenant_isolation_modify. seedTenant seeds the four mutable/guarded tables via adminClient: a FeeStructure (ACTIVE) + FeeComponent (TUITION, 5000000n paise) + a StudentCharge (PENDING) on the ALREADY-seeded studentProfile + a payment_transactions CREATED (non-terminal) row with targetChargeIds=[charge]. TEARDOWN APPROACH (documented decision): the three fully append-only tables are NOT seeded by the generic loop (their trigger blocks even adminClient — the application_reviews precedent); payment_transactions + student_charges carry the column-guard triggers that forbid DELETE UNCONDITIONALLY, so cleanup() deletes them (child-first: payment_transactions -> student_charges -> fee_components -> fee_structures) within a scoped DISABLE/ENABLE TRIGGER dance (the audit_events precedent) placed FIRST in cleanup (fees reference student_profiles/programs/sessions ON DELETE RESTRICT). countRemainingTestRows() += the four seeded tables (the three append-only ones are never seeded, so not counted). New escape cases (3fa-3fg + 3fj): read-escape, spoofed-tenant insert, foreign-parent composite-FK (component->foreign structure; charge->foreign student), spoofed update (updateMany count 0), buggy-query backstop, unset/empty-GUC fail-closed, AND a self-contained one-tenant case that inserts into each of the three append-only tables, proves cross-tenant SELECT empty, and asserts UPDATE+DELETE denied (REVOKE + trigger), cleaning up within a scoped trigger-disable. Case-6 policy meta-test append-only list += payment_allocations/receipts/processed_webhook_events (asserts NO tenant_isolation_modify). tenant-escape in isolation: 68 tests PASS.

FAST/MOCKED UNIT SUITE (apps/api/src/services/fees/__tests__/fees-unit.test.ts, 43 tests, no DB): HMAC verifyPaymentSignature/verifyWebhookSignature valid/invalid/constant-time(length-guard) with a known secret; webhook field extraction from the nested payload (payment-event order_id vs order-event id, HIGH-1); the BigInt->Number boundary guard (rejects 0n and >MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, accepts a realistic amount + exactly MAX_SAFE_INTEGER losslessly); planAllocation/computeOutstanding/chargeOutstanding/nextChargeStatus/compareChargesForAllocation (oldest-due-first, NULLS LAST, partial/full, overpayment-leaves-remainder, all-targets-PAID, sum<=amount); money-as-string serialization; forward-only charge-status transition logic; receiptNumber/sequence format; the PaiseAmount Zod schema (accepts a positive paise string; rejects '0', leading zero, decimal, signs, non-numeric, >MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, and a JSON-number input); the Razorpay service with a mocked SDK (order create + fetch/fetchPayments reconcile reads); and the fail-closed role probe (webhook returns 500 when the injected lookup client reports rolbypassrls=false, BEFORE any order lookup) + the 401-before-DB signature-reject path.

LIVE-DB BEHAVIORAL SUITE (apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/fees-behavioral.integration.test.ts, 12 tests, glob registered by FEAT-002 in vitest.live-db-suites.ts): real Fastify app (real authenticate + feesRoutes + razorpay-webhook), DATABASE_URL pinned to campass_app, the webhook's owner-role lookup client INJECTED as the BYPASSRLS adminClient (so the fail-closed probe passes) + a deterministic RazorpayGateway stub with known KEY_SECRET/WEBHOOK_SECRET set process-wide via setRazorpayGateway. HEADLINES: duplicate webhook twice -> exactly one CAPTURED tx/receipt/allocation + second delivery 200 'duplicate'; tampered signature -> 401 writes nothing + NO audit row; invalid Stage-2 signature -> 400 no charge paid/no receipt + tx stays CREATED; charge PENDING->PAID only after the webhook (Stage-2 verify leaves it AUTHORIZED); exact paise math end-to-end + allocation sum<=payment + ledger outstanding==0; module-SUSPENDED op route 403 while the webhook stays signature-gated (bad sig 401) and 200-no-ops with fees.webhook.skipped_module_inactive, then captures after re-activation (money not lost); ACCOUNTANT is fees-scoped (403 on the student self-service route; STUDENT 403 on manage); a STUDENT sees only their own ledger; the append-only triggers reject UPDATE/DELETE and the column guards reject reverse transition / terminal re-update / targetChargeIds mutation / snapshot-amount change / any DELETE. NITs: (1) a ghost/foreign targetChargeIds entry contributes zero allocation; (2) reconcile leaves a still-open order CREATED and only drives FAILED on a terminal-failed Razorpay signal; (3) a NON-23505 processed-event insert failure (forced via a temporary CHECK) returns 500 and rolls back (Razorpay retries). fees-behavioral in isolation: 12 tests PASS.

FEAT-002 DEFECT FOUND + FIXED IN PLACE (Option A, per parent-session decision): the committed webhook/confirmation code passed actorUserId:'system' to recordAuditEvent, but audit_events.actorUserId FKs users(id) and no 'system' user exists, so EVERY real webhook capture hit an FK violation -> the whole tenant tx rolled back -> 500 (it would fail on every real payment in production; the pre-tenant .catch()-swallowed audits silently wrote nothing). FIX (A): confirmCapture.ts now resolves the PAYER's User id up-front (studentProfile.userId, falling back to transaction.initiatedByUserId) and records fees.payment.captured/reconciled + fees.receipt.issued under that real id with actorRoleKey 'STUDENT'; if neither resolves it skips the audit best-effort (never rolls back a captured payment) and returns auditSkipped so the caller logs a warning. razorpay-webhook.ts: the fees.webhook.received no-op + skipped_module_inactive + duplicate_ignored audits now use the resolved payer id (resolved via the lookupClient join student->userId); the pre-tenant, institutionId:null paths (signature_rejected, unknown order) are now structured request.log.warn lines, NOT DB audit writes (no valid actor/tenant). Rejected B (seed a system user) and C (make actorUserId nullable — weakens audit integrity + touches frozen-migration discipline). confirmCapture.ts + razorpay-webhook.ts are the only app-code files touched.

DOCS: docs/roadmap.md gained (a) a Phase-7 slice-1 entry in the deferred-frontend scope list (Option A backend-only; apps/web fees screens deferred) and (b) a Phase-7 'Slice 1 — SHIPPED' + 'Slice 7.1 — DEFERRED' block (scholarships/concessions/waivers/adjustments/refunds/reports land as NEW ledger-entry tables + new allocation entries + forward charge-status transitions, never edits to posted student_charges/CAPTURED payment_transactions/payment_allocations/receipts; fees.refund/fees.adjust are forward-declared unbound keys wired with MFA step-up in 7.1).

VERIFICATION (recorded in the commit message):
- npx tsc --noEmit (apps/api): clean.
- npm test -w @campusgate/api (fast): 41 files / 425 tests PASS (382 baseline + 43 new fees unit tests).
- npm ci (repo root) + npm run db:generate + npm test -w @campusgate/api: 425 PASS (clean build).
- npm run test:integration -w @campusgate/api (live smoke): 10 files / 147 tests PASS (fees-behavioral + extended tenant-escape over all 7 fees tables + re-pointed module-system, all green together). Earlier combined-run failures were transient free-tier session-pooler errors (max clients / P1001) — each suite passes in isolation (tenant-escape 68, fees-behavioral 12) and the final combined re-run is fully green; this is the documented vitest.live-db-suites flakiness, retried per the harness convention.

No .env or real Razorpay keys staged. NOT pushed, NOT deployed.
